test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which statement is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: In the last 14 years, 10 leopards have died in Haryana due to road accidents.
The leopard was a three-year-old male.
The leopard had to be tranquilised before being put into the cage.
It took the rescue team just 10 minutes to put the leopard in the cage.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The leopard had to be tranquilised before being put into the cage."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If we refer to the last line of the 2nd paragraph "**In the last 14 years, 10 leopards have died in road accidents in south Haryana**."

 
 
• ​It is clearly mentioned that ten leopards have died.
 
• **Thus, it can be concluded that this statement is correct**.
 
 
 
• If we refer to the first line of the passage "**A three-year-old** male leopard was hit by a speeding vehicle" 
 
 
• ​It is mentioned that the age of the leopard was 3 years old.
 
• **Thus, it can be concluded that this statement is correct**.
 
 
 
• if we refer to the line "It was conscious and our team lifted it carefully and put it in the cage.** We didn’t tranquilise it**.
 
 
• **Thus, it can be concluded that this statement is not correct**.
 
 
 
• If we refer to the last line of the third paragraph "As the leopard was injured, it took the team just **10 minutes **to put the big cat in the cage".
 
 
• It is clearly mentioned that It took ten minutes.
 
• **Thus, it can be concluded that this statement is correct**
 
 
 
• So option 3 is the correct answer.
